items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Rag Baby and Paul. ... Well, it was Paul and I. We used to call it the Rusty Rail Blues.

ctx.x: George Brunus The Musical Brunus Family It's going okay.

Good morning ladies and gentlemen. This is George Brunus of the Musical Brunus Family of New Orleans. It's a little in the view, the gentleman would like to know, I was born New Orleans, the Irish Channel, February 6th, 1902. I'm now 56 years of age, going pretty strong for my age. I came up from New Orleans. There was a telegram sent by a drummer that came up here first, Rag Baby Stevens. He was working at a place called the Campbell Gardens on Campbell and Madison and he sent me a wire for my brother Albert,…
